summary_en: Annual dividend per share raised to 27.00 yen from 23.00 yen, with interim dividend increased to 15.00 yen from 11.00 yen, while full-year earnings forecasts were also upgraded due to strong orders in the electronic components sector.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of FY2027 Second Quarter Individual Earnings Forecast, Full-Year Earnings Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Nikkato Corporation raised its full-year dividend forecast to 27.00 yen per share from the previously announced 23.00 yen per share for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The interim dividend was increased to 15.00 yen from 11.00 yen, while the year-end dividend remains at 12.00 yen. The company simultaneously upgraded its full-year earnings forecasts: net income per share to 75.28 yen from 66.92 yen, operating profit to 1,220 million yen from 1,100 million yen, and ordinary profit to 1,290 million yen from 1,150 million yen.

The revision reflects stronger-than-expected performance in the first half of the fiscal year. The company achieved higher-than-anticipated orders driven by active demand in its main customer segment, the electronic components industry. Both operating profit and ordinary profit substantially exceeded initial forecasts, prompting the dividend and earnings revisions.

The company maintained the year-end dividend at 12.00 yen rather than increasing it further, citing uncertainty from geopolitical risks in the Middle East and export restrictions on rare earth materials from China. Management indicated that these factors create an unfavorable operating environment with unpredictable impacts on second-half performance, warranting caution for the final dividend.
